info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Status API provides an overview of the current status of pets available for adoption. This endpoint allows users to retrieve real-time information about pets, including their availability and other relevant details. Common consumers of this API include pet adoption agencies, animal shelters, and developers creating applications that facilitate pet adoption. By integrating this API, organizations can ensure that potential adopters have access to up-to-date status information, thereby enhancing the adoption process.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of all pets.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of various pets. You can use this to check if pets are available for adoption, if they are in a specific condition, or any other relevant status information.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of pets. This body must comply with the schema definitions outlined in the components section. Ensure that the JSON structure aligns with expected parameters for accurate processing.

200.description: The request was successful, and pet status information is returned.

ListPetadoptionPetsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the status of the pets in the application. It is expected to be a string value that indicates the current state or status of the pets.
